chunks.head: catch hold of
chunks.note: catch hold of sth/sb = 一把抓住;occ 里 catched 是旧式过去式。
chunks.ex_en: The child caught hold of his mother's hand.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子一把抓住了妈妈的手。

chunks.head: stand still
chunks.note: still 此处是'不动的',不是'仍然'。
chunks.ex_en: Please stand still while I take the photo.
chunks.ex_cn: 我拍照时请你站着别动。

chunks.head: a great many
chunks.note: a great many + 可数名词复数,强调数量多。
chunks.ex_en: A great many people came to the show.
chunks.ex_cn: 很多人来看演出。

chunks.head: wear off
chunks.note: 多指感觉、效果、新鲜劲随时间慢慢消退。
chunks.ex_en: The pain will wear off in an hour.
chunks.ex_cn: 疼痛一个小时后就会消退。

chunks.head: by himself
chunks.note: by oneself = 独自一人(可换 myself/herself 等)。
chunks.ex_en: He fixed the bike by himself.
chunks.ex_cn: 他独自把自行车修好了。

chunks.head: so much as
chunks.note: not so much as = 甚至连…都不,强调完全没有。
chunks.ex_en: He left without so much as a goodbye.
chunks.ex_cn: 他走了,连声再见都没说。

chunks.head: care for
chunks.note: 本章义为'喜欢/想要';否定和疑问里很常见。
chunks.ex_en: Would you care for a cup of tea?
chunks.ex_cn: 你想喝杯茶吗?

chunks.head: on the other hand
chunks.note: 用于引出相反或对比的一面。
chunks.ex_en: I want to travel; on the other hand, I need to save money.
chunks.ex_cn: 我想去旅行;另一方面,我又得攒钱。

chunks.head: at last
chunks.note: 经过等待或努力之后终于发生。
chunks.ex_en: After a long wait, the bus at last arrived.
chunks.ex_cn: 等了很久,公交车终于来了。

chunks.head: a great deal
chunks.note: a great deal (of + 不可数) = 很多;也可单独作副词'很多'。
chunks.ex_en: She knows a great deal about plants.
chunks.ex_cn: 她对植物懂得很多。

chunks.head: in short
chunks.note: 用于对前面内容作简短总结。
chunks.ex_en: In short, we need more time.
chunks.ex_cn: 总之,我们需要更多时间。

chunks.head: get the better
chunks.note: get the better of sb/sth = 胜过、克制不住(情绪战胜了自己)。
chunks.ex_en: Curiosity got the better of me, so I opened the box.
chunks.ex_cn: 好奇心占了上风,我把盒子打开了。

chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: 与'在海上'相对,指登陆或在陆地上。
chunks.ex_en: The sailors were glad to be on shore again.
chunks.ex_cn: 水手们很高兴又能上岸了。

chunks.head: make one's escape
chunks.note: make one's escape = 成功逃走(one's 可换 his/her 等)。
chunks.ex_en: The thief made his escape through the window.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷从窗户逃走了。

chunks.head: by degrees
chunks.note: 表示缓慢、分阶段地发生。
chunks.ex_en: By degrees the room grew warm.
chunks.ex_cn: 房间渐渐暖和起来。

chunks.head: in order to
chunks.note: in order to + 动词原形,表示目的。
chunks.ex_en: He got up early in order to catch the train.
chunks.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上火车。

chunks.head: clear up
chunks.note: clear up a misunderstanding/mystery = 把疑团或误会说清楚。
chunks.ex_en: Let me clear up the misunderstanding.
chunks.ex_cn: 让我把这个误会说清楚。

chunks.head: refrain from
chunks.note: refrain from + 动名词 = 忍住不做某事。
chunks.ex_en: Please refrain from talking during the film.
chunks.ex_cn: 看电影时请不要交谈。

chunks.head: go on with
chunks.note: go on with sth = 接着做、继续进行某事。
chunks.ex_en: Let's go on with the lesson.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们继续上课吧。

chunks.head: to pieces
chunks.note: fall/break/tear to pieces = 碎成一片片。
chunks.ex_en: The old vase fell to pieces.
chunks.ex_cn: 那只旧花瓶碎成了碎片。

chunks.head: what is the matter
chunks.note: 关切地问对方发生了什么;occ 为过去式 what was the matter。
chunks.ex_en: You look sad—what is the matter?
chunks.ex_cn: 你看起来很难过——怎么了?

chunks.head: in spite of
chunks.note: in spite of + 名词/动名词 = 尽管有…(=despite)。

literal.note_cn: 原义'恶意',此固定式中不译'恶意'

chunks.ex_en: In spite of the rain, we went out.
chunks.ex_cn: 尽管下着雨,我们还是出门了。
